description:
Replace an agent's mascot spec or change its welcome message. A spec replaces the old one whole, so send the full spec with your changes in it. Sharing the mascot publicly (which lets strangers call the agent on the account's credit) is done in the console, not here. For a new look made on the server, use generate_agent_mascot.

Requires scope `agents:write`.

spec.description: A mascot spec: { name, color: "#rrggbb", shape: { kind: circle|drop|triangle|cloud|pill|flower|squircle|blob|heart, rotation, aspect, seed }, eyes: { style: pill|round|block|line, color, width, height, gap, x, y, tilt, turn }, personality: { bounce: 0..1, energy: 0..1 } }. Sizes are in body units (the body is 2 units tall). The server drops unknown fields and clamps numbers; the answer shows the spec as saved. To edit one, start from get_agent's mascot.spec.

welcome_message.description: What the mascot's speech bubble says on the share page and website widget before a call. Empty uses the agent's opening line.

name: update_agent_mascot
title: Update an agent's mascot
